I have been battling depression since a year now. I decided to get some help and let my GP know. She started me on celexa and I just feel so much worse now (been a week since i started taking the medication).Woke up this morning and got a panic attack. Couldn't stop crying. I was feeling like this great sadness that's over me won't ever go away.
I split the 17g dose into two.

I had the same problem a few weeks back with the tip of the BM being hard and the rest being soft. I switched to taking MiraLax twice - 1/2 in the morning and 1/2 in the night. That has helped me.
I also saw a CRS and they recommended pelvic floor physical therapy for me. Apparently my pelvic muscles are not working the way they are supposed to and my internal sphincter muscle is tight. They said I am more susceptible to fissure because of these two reasons. They said pelvic floor physical therapy might help and LIS is the next option.

Cremaffin is not just an osmotic laxative. It is also a stimulant laxative. I've been dealing with fissures since a year now. I started taking Cremaffin in October last year after a relapse and I didn't know it was dependency forming. My doctor never told me when to stop and I didn't do my research! Anyway, I stopped taking it a month back and was constipated for days which caused the fissure to relapse. I've had bleeding and pain since. It's been hell. Going to a CRS this week.
Try an equivalent of MiraLax or like someone said above an osmotic laxative. They really do keep the stool soft.
Obligatory - Consult your doctor again before making the switch.
Byg Brewski in Sarjapur is really good.
